issues.legal_issue: Insufficient funds to pay court fees do not constitute sufficient cause to condone delay in filing an appeal where the appellant could have filed a deficient appeal and later paid the fee under Section 149 of the Code of Civil Procedure.

An assignment of contractual rights to a prospective purchaser does not support specific performance where the agreement did not authorize assignment and the seller's prior consent or approval was not obtained.

A transfer structure that uses an agriculturist assignee to facilitate a non-agricultural use of land cannot be used to circumvent the restrictions and purpose of Section 118 of the Himachal Pradesh Tenancy and Land Reforms Act.
